issue.title: Update launch test mocks for origin argument
issue.description: On c2aec595c8, tests/test_partial_launch_cleanup.py::test_launch_query_rolls_back_partial_multi_prompt_launch fails because fail_launch lacks origin; tests/test_bead/test_cli_work_cleanup_confirm.py::test_yes_still_prompts_for_cleanup_but_skips_launch_prompt fails because _seed_live_collision mock lacks origin. Phase notes report 22 test_cli_work failures and 2 errors with the same clean-tree family. Update launch mocks across affected tests without weakening launch assertions, then run the family.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both representative nodes fail deterministically in focused serial runs on current clean HEAD with the same unexpected origin keyword TypeError.

issue.creation_reason: Phases sase-1ck.4.1.1 and sase-1ck.4.1.3 proposed clean-tree launch-family failures; current HEAD reproduces the stale mock signature after the origin argument landed in eaa4aa4aa7.

payload.description: checking whether pre-existing check failure is already tracked

payload.entry: Resolved by 8c38eb6a9a (fix(master-gate): 'Update stale origin-kwarg test fakes/assertions across launch seams'). Verified by the sase-1cj land agent on HEAD 4fce27e507: tests/test_partial_launch_cleanup.py + tests/test_bead/test_cli_work_cleanup_confirm.py 16 passed, and the whole tests/test_bead cli_work + partial_launch family 277 passed with no origin TypeError. The origin kwarg came from sase-1cj.2 (eaa4aa4aa7).

evidence.note: Recurrence on HEAD 8fdead6466 (2026-10-01), tree contains resolving commit 8c38eb6a9a: tests/test_partial_launch_cleanup.py::test_launch_query_rolls_back_partial_multi_prompt_launch fails deterministically (isolated serial run) with TypeError: fail_launch() got an unexpected keyword argument 'history_text' from src/sase/main/query_handler/_launch.py:330. New kwarg landed in ce0f61846c after this bead closed; the fail_launch mock needs history_text added the same way origin was. Unrelated to the g-prefix split: git blame attributes the kwarg to ce0f61846c, and neither the test nor _launch.py references g_prefix.

Recurrence on clean master 0abe894140 (sase-1dq land verification; proposed by sase-1dq.8--1): tests/test_partial_launch_cleanup.py::test_launch_query_rolls_back_partial_multi_prompt_launch fails with TypeError fail_launch() got an unexpected keyword argument 'history_text', and tests/test_force_reuse_launch_seam_rejection.py (test_plain_sase_run_without_request_sidecar_still_rejects_forced_reuse, test_sidecar_without_authorization_still_rejects_forced_reuse) fail on assert {'origin': ..., 'history_text': None} == {'origin': 'typed'} — same stale-launch-mock family, now for the history_text kwarg. Unrelated to sase-1dq (no next-word code on these paths).
